newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Adolfo Dominguez IPO hugely oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Adolfo Dominguez IPO hugely oversubscribed.

text.p: The intial public offering of shares in Spanish fashion design house Adolfo Dominguez is so far oversubscribed by 100 times on the Spanish institutional tranche, and by 75 times on the retail tranche, sale co-ordinators Banco Central Hispano said on Wednesday.
Demand for the international tranche so far outstrips shares on offer by 40 times.
The bidding period closes on Thursday, and the price will be set at a maximum of 3,100 pesetas per share.
The flotation is for 70 percent of the firm's capital, initially 5.4 million shares, expandable to around 5.9 million.
Adolfo Dominguez will be listed in Madrid for the first time on March 18.
